verdictMeaning: Yellow means suspicious signals accumulated without a definitive signature. Someone experienced should review the findings below before anyone runs this code.

findings.why: The dependency "lodasg" is one keystroke away from the popular package "lodash". Attackers publish lookalike names so that a hurried reader sees the name they expect. It could be an unrelated legitimate package, but the resemblance is exactly what typosquatting exploits.
findings.next: Look up "lodasg" on npmjs.com: check its weekly downloads and publish date before trusting it.

findings.why: This package runs a "prepare" script automatically when you type npm install, and also when the package is installed from a git source, before you review or run anything. That is common in legitimate projects (copying files, setting up tooling), but it is also the entry point malware uses.
findings.next: Read what the "prepare" script actually does (and any file it invokes) before installing.
